hook: nobody is going to pick you
lines: For the perfect moment. The perfect *plan.*
#Here's the truth. Nobody is coming to *pick* you.
Waiting for the right job. The right *partner.*
#The people living the life you want didn't get *permission.*
Messy. Unsure. Scared out of their *minds.*
They learned on the way. They *adjusted* on the way.
#Ready is not a feeling you *wait* for.
So stop asking if you're allowed to *dream* that big.
end: Send this to someone who keeps waiting.

post.title: Stop Waiting for Permission to Start
post.caption: Ready isn't a feeling you wait for. It's something you become. 🌅 Consider this your permission.
post.first_comment: What have you been waiting to start? 👇
